survey: A round analog clock standing upright on a green ledge, facing the camera almost straight on with a slight turn. Parts: a thick orange round case with a soft rounded rim; a white dial inside it with 12 navy hour marks (longer marks at 12, 3, 6 and 9) and small navy minute dots between them; a short thick navy hour hand pointing just past 10 and a longer navy minute hand pointing at 2 (10:10); a thin red second hand pointing toward 7; all three hands meet at one red center cap. The bottom of the case rests on the ledge and casts a contact shadow. The case stays round, the marks are evenly spaced and complete, the hour hand is shorter than the minute hand, and the hands sit where they should for 10:10. The clock has no feet, but a round desk clock resting on its rim is a normal card simplification.
